claims: The Code of Ethical Conduct frames architect duties through relationship sections.
Client duties include scope/fee clarity, advice against questionable projects, conditional estimates, no outside returns, disclosure, and arbitration clause.
Contractor duties include clear documents, fair administration, and rejection of nonconforming work.
Supplier duties prohibit private reciprocal benefits, while permitted market discounts are credited to the client.
Colleague/subordinate duties include direct-supervision sealing, fair employment, mentoring, and information sharing.
